visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Scene opens at the Kansai-airport Station. Several travelers are walking with suitcases toward the exit. The lighting is bright and industrial. (2) Transition to an outdoor street featuring a modern, minimalist white house with black window frames. A male presenter in a light beige short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers walks toward the front door. (3) Interior view of a living room with wooden flooring and white walls. A woman is seen briefly in a mirror reflection. The presenter gestures toward a wooden dining table and stools. (4) A group of four individuals is shown lounging on a grey fabric sofa in a spacious living room. They are watching a television screen which displays an animated film. The room has high windows and soft, warm lighting. (5) Montage of the guesthouse facilities: a bedroom with tatami mats and futons, a western-style bedroom with a blue bedspread, and a white-tiled bathroom with a washing machine. (6) Handheld shots of kitchen appliances, including a microwave, toaster, and refrigerator. The presenter is seen drinking from a bottle inside the kitchen. (7) Close-up shots of hands placing bath salt packets into a white bathtub; the water turns pink and fizzes. A woman is seen having breakfast in a brightly lit dining area. (8) Outdoor scenes at the Osaka Aquarium and Universal Studios Japan, featuring large colorful structures and a Pikachu character. (9) The final scene shows three people with large pink and green suitcases walking out of the white house's driveway. They are waving or adjusting bags, dressed in casual summer attire.

(5) [Subtitle]: 最愛的就是二樓整層的超大客廳. (6) [Subtitle]: 大家常常窩在這裡一起看麻瓜影片. (7) [Subtitle]: 追《母胎單身大作戰》追到半夜. (8) [Subtitle]: 還一起起鬨要Flynn親下去(?). (9) [Subtitle]: 住著住著感情就更好好了~. (10) [Subtitle]: 整體風格是質感滿滿的無印風. (11) [Subtitle]: 怎麼拍怎麼好看. (12) [Subtitle]: 一樓有一間榻榻米房. (13) [Subtitle]: 三樓則是兩間雙人房. (14) [Subtitle]: 每間房都有衣帽間. (15) [Variety]: 超讚!. (16) [Subtitle]: 浴室新又乾淨. (17) [Subtitle]: 水量很夠、浴缸也夠大. (18) [Subtitle]: 還準備了各地的溫泉入浴劑. (19) [Subtitle]: 香香的泡起來超舒服~. (20) [Subtitle]: 而且廁所有兩間. (21) [Subtitle]: 不怕團員太愛大便. (22) [Subtitle]: 開放式廚房質感也很好. (23) [Subtitle]: 鍋子、烤箱、碗盤餐具通通有. (24) [Subtitle]: 冰箱裡還有老闆貼心準備的茶. (25) [Subtitle]: 早上烤片吐司、泡杯咖啡. (26) [Subtitle]: 整個早晨都變得很chill~. (27) [Subtitle]: 隔天搭兩站就能到海遊館. (28) [Subtitle]: 晚上走10分鐘就到空庭溫泉泡湯. (29) [Subtitle]: 無縫轉乘15分鐘就到環球影城. (30) [Subtitle]: 在這裡住了三晚. [Variety]: 真的大滿意!
